preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) for row in grid)
preconditions.description: Each row in the grid is a list.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cell, str) for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is a string.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in ['X', 'O'] for row in grid for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid contains either 'X' or 'O'.
The number of rows in the grid is between 1 and 100.
The number of columns in the grid is between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The number of 'X' shapes is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(grid)) for j in range(len(grid[i])) if grid[i][j] == 'X')
postconditions.description: The number of 'X' shapes is equal to the total number of 'X' cells in the grid.
